title: Cluster Learning Dossier F02 Mechanical Maintenance: Synthetic pump fire, 2024
status: Learning purposes: not a statutory document

bottom_line.text: Return to service had no test step, and the crew restarted the pump untested.

items.decision: Make a signed leak test a hold point on every return to service

items.name: Restarts with a test record
items.measure: % of restarts with a signed leak-test record

items.text: S13 Comparison is left out: no comparator report was supplied.

items.lesson: Restarting without a test went unchallenged because nothing asked for one.
items.explanation: The work order shows no test [EVD-0001].

items.lesson: An unfamiliar seal gave no cue that a test mattered more than usual.
items.explanation: The findings show local seals without a specification [FND-0003].

items.lesson: Supervisors had no checklist to refuse a restart against.
items.explanation: The procedure index has no entry [EVD-0002].

items.lesson: The spares programme let critical seals in without a specification.
items.explanation: Purchase records show local buying since March 2022 [EVD-0003].

items.text: Maintenance fits what stores buys, and neither side checked the specification [FND-0003; FND-0001].

items.lesson: Maintenance and stores need one owner for the specification of a critical spare.

items.barrier: Leak test before return to service

items.text: Do not restart without a signed leak-test record [FND-0001].
Make the leak test a hold point you sign [FND-0002].

items.change: Signed leak-test hold point on every return to service
items.barrier: Leak test before return to service
items.indicator: % of restarts with a test record
